# SYNESIS_E073 — Error

## Description

Annotations file `file.syn` declared in the project was not found.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The annotations file `file.syn` is declared in INCLUDE ANNOTATIONS
  but was not found. The annotations it should contain are neither
  loaded nor validated.
  Check that the name is correct and that the file exists. The path must be
  relative to the folder of the project file (`.synp`).
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **MissingAnnotationsFile**: `filename`
